# Fun.com

> > Fun.com is a premier destination for licensed collectibles, toys, gifts, and merchandise featuring beloved franchises like Star Wars, Marvel, DC Comics, Disney, and Harry Potter.

Fun.com specializes in curated gift collections and officially licensed merchandise across popular entertainment properties. The site offers products for fans of all ages, from apparel and costumes to collectibles and home décor items.

## Key Topics

- Star Wars
- Marvel
- Disney
- DC Comics
- Harry Potter
- Collectibles
- Licensed merchandise
- Costumes
- Apparel
- Toys
- Loungefly
- Cakeworthy
- Gift guides
- Character merchandise
- Gifts for adults and kids

## Franchise & Character Collections

- [Star Wars Gifts](https://www.fun.com/star-wars-gifts.html): Star Wars merchandise and gifts for fans of all ages
- [Marvel Gifts](https://www.fun.com/marvel-gifts.html): Marvel gifts including Spider-Man, Iron Man, Avengers merchandise
- [DC Comics Gifts](https://www.fun.com/dc-gifts.html): DC Comics gifts featuring Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman collectibles
- [Harry Potter Gifts](https://www.fun.com/harry-potter-gifts.html): Harry Potter collectibles, apparel, toys from Wizarding World
- [Disney Gifts](https://www.fun.com/disney-gifts.html): Disney gifts featuring Aladdin, Frozen, Beauty and Beast characters
- [Avengers Gifts](https://www.fun.com/avengers-gifts.html): Avengers merchandise including Captain America, Iron Man, Thor gifts
- [Batman Gifts](https://www.fun.com/batman-gifts.html): Batman merchandise, costumes, and gifts from DC Comics
- [Back to the Future Gifts](https://www.fun.com/back-to-the-future-gifts.html): Licensed Back to the Future gifts and costumes featuring DeLorean

## Disney Character Collections

- [Aladdin Gifts](https://www.fun.com/aladdin-gifts.html): Aladdin merchandise and gifts including costumes and character items
- [Beauty and the Beast Gifts](https://www.fun.com/beauty-and-the-beast-gifts.html): Beauty and Beast Disney gifts and costumes for adults and kids
- [Alice in Wonderland Gifts](https://www.fun.com/alice-in-wonderland-gifts.html): Alice in Wonderland gifts, costumes, and merchandise from Disney
